 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY
ORAL ORDER 6 12-04-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the respondents.

The petitioner has filed the instant application for the following relief(s):
"(i) For a direction to the Respondents to pay the amount of compensation within a stipulated period to the land owner petitioner for the acquired land belonging to the petitioner for construction of high level R.C.C. Bridge on Chakiya - Kesariya Sattar Ghat Road falling within the District of East Champaran.

(ii) For and for any other relief(s) for which the petitioners are found to be entitled in the facts and circumstance of the case."
Patna High Court CWJC No.14517 of 2019(6) dt.12-04-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the payment not having been made to the petitioner for acquisition of various plots of land vide Land Acquisition Case no.25/2017- 18, the petitioner was constrained to file the instant application.

The details of the award number and the land has been given in paragraph no.6 and 7 of Uma Shankar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 12 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103384209/

The details of the compensational Awards are the following:-

That as per the notice issued to the land owners in connection with Land Acquisition Case No.25/17-18 and different awards it is clear that description of the land has also been given.

For the easy understanding of the land acquisition description is given below:
Patna High Court CWJC No.14517 of 2019(6) dt.12-04-2023 Award No. Khata No.
Khesra No. Rakba of land to be acquired 49 199 2729 68 Decimals 58 259 2760 52 Decimals 61 199 2764 138 Decimals 63 88 2765 39.5 Decimals 66 242 2768 62.5 Decimals.

"
At this stage, learned counsel for the respondents submits that a counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent nos.2, 3 and 4 wherein it has been stated that the District Land Acquisition Officer finalised the award and notices were issued to the interested raiyats under section 37(2) of the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Pursuant to the notices issued,
one awardee namely, Sri Devendra Singh filed his objection petition along with rent receipts,
photocopy of khatiyan, family tree etc.

Thereafter as per section 76 of the Land Acquisition Act,
2013, the matter has been referred to the authority (LARRA) Tirhut Division at Muzaffarpur where the same is pending.
In view of the above, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioner to appear before the Authority (LARRA), Tirhut Division, Muzaffarpur.

The petitioner will be at liberty to file a petition bringing to the notice of the Authority and raising all the points which have been raised in the instant writ Patna High Court CWJC No.14517 of 2019(6) dt.12-04-2023 application as also which may be available to the petitioner.

The Authority shall consider the submissions raised by the petitioner and proceed to decide the same in accordance with law at the earliest preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt/communication of this order.
It may be clarified here that this Court has not entered into the merits of the case of the parties which will be decided by the Authority concerned.
This application stands disposed of with the above observations and directions.
